crossRefs.note: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd…
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought…
But don’t you be called ‘Rabbi,’ for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ…

translations.web: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
translations.bsb: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.
translations.kjv: Ye are bought with a price; be ➔ not ye the servants of men.
translations.asv: Ye were bought with a price; become not bondservants of men.
